title: Filaments
bodyHtml:
Created as part of "Re-tissons le territoire" in the Communauté de Communes de L’Ouest Rhodanien (C.O.R) this show based on various which collect (testimonials, images, sounds) traces the history of textiles in the region.

With:
  • Alejandra SANTANDER: voice, sound objects, images videos
  • Didier BOYAT: guitars, sound objects, sound, mixing
  • Nicolas PELLIER: drums, percussion
  • Guillaume GRENARD: bass, trumpet, tuba, percussion
  • Claude HUSSON: lights
  • Éric GIRARD: staging
